analysis.description: Worked mechanics example using genuine Inspect outputs from GPT-4o. Incorrect answers are treated as failures. This is a reliability example, not evidence of deployment safety.
analysis.title: Eight real SimpleQA items as a fixed-design failure analysis

reasons: Bounds do not establish either the acceptable or unacceptable region.
claims.title: Equal-weight fixed-design mean failure risk is acceptable

scope.disclaimer: Results apply to the declared fixed evaluation set and specified stochastic rollout process. They do not estimate failure prevalence over an external population of prompts or establish safety for omitted hazards or deployment conditions.
